language.title: Language
language.description: Panel interface, date and number formats
language.label: Interface language
language.hint: The choice is stored on the device and survives a restart.

contrast.title: High legibility
contrast.description: Maximum contrast for sunlight and reflections
contrast.label: High contrast mode
contrast.hint: Pure black, crisp borders and full-strength text: stays readable by a window or in direct sun.

reasons.manual: Turned on manually from the panel.
reasons.system: Requested by the operating system (prefers-contrast: more).
reasons.watching: Light sensor active: {{lux}} lux, below the {{threshold}} lux threshold.
reasons.noReading: Light sensor active: waiting for the first reading.
reasons.unsupported: Light sensor unavailable: activation stays manual.
reasons.systemHint: The operating system still requests high contrast.

performance.title: Performance mode
performance.description: Maximum smoothness on slow displays and Raspberry Pi
performance.label: Performance mode (slow displays / Raspberry Pi)
performance.hint: Disables blur, transparency and heavy shadows to keep the panel smooth on low-power hardware.
performance.note: Removes backdrop blur, shadows and gradients and trims micro-animations. The choice stays saved on this device.

sync.title: Topology sync
sync.description: Rooms and devices updated instantly on every panel in the house.
sync.hint: Received events are batched into a single refresh: Immediate reacts to every single change, higher values avoid repeated requests during bulk edits or reordering.

broker.title: MQTT broker
broker.description: LAN WebSocket connection · settings applied to the panel
broker.clientIdHint: Must be unique on the broker.
broker.demoHint: Simulates devices without opening sockets to the broker.
broker.pinDescription: Changing the broker connection requires an elevated session.
broker.pinAction: Enter your PIN to apply the settings.

kiosk.title: Kiosk
kiosk.summary: Fade {{fade}} ms · clock at {{opacity}}% in sleep · {{mode}} every {{seconds}} s · touch guard {{guard}} ms.
kiosk.wakeLockUnsupported: WakeLock not supported by this browser

display.title: This display
display.description: Name and identifier this panel uses to load its configuration from PostgreSQL.
display.name: Display name
display.idHint: Generated at first boot and stored in a ten-year cookie. A new id applies at the next start, when the panel adopts that display's configuration.
display.invalidId: Invalid id: letters, digits, dot, dash, colon or underscore (max 64).
display.idAppliedHint: The panel loads {{id}} at the next start.

health.title: Device health
health.description: Battery, JS heap and MQTT latency of this panel, live

api.supportedHint: This browser exposes the Battery Status API: battery telemetry is published to the broker.
api.unsupportedHint: This browser does not expose the Battery Status API (e.g. Safari/iPadOS): no invented numbers and no telemetry published.

memory.title: JS heap
memory.hint: Browser JavaScript heap: above 85% the panel gets slow and should be reloaded.
memory.unavailableHint: performance.memory is not exposed by this browser (Chromium only): the value is unavailable.

telemetry.note: Battery telemetry for the smart plug: every {{seconds}} s on {{topic}} (QoS 1, retained), plus on every level or charging change.

history.title: Database checks history
history.description: PostgreSQL connectivity and latency audit, refreshed automatically.
history.empty: No checks recorded yet: the history fills up at the gateway's first health check.
history.offlineStale: Database unreachable: showing the last saved history ({{when}}).
history.offlineEmpty: Database unreachable: no saved history to show.

pin.title: Panel PIN
pin.description: Protects loads, resets and critical scenarios
pin.errorLength: The PIN must contain 4 to 6 digits.
pin.errorMismatch: The two PINs do not match.
pin.note: The PIN is stored as a bcrypt hash in the gateway database. Verification and the authoritative lockout are server-side; the panel adds a persistent local lockout as defense in depth.
pin.confirmDescription: Verification happens on the gateway; the new PIN never leaves the server.

raw.title: Topic test · RAW monitor
raw.description: Last {{count}} messages · in/out from the MQTT client
raw.empty: Waiting for messages… publish a test or wait for a telemetry update.

users.sessionNote: The profile comes from /api/auth/me, not from a file compiled into the bundle. Profile switching is verified by the gateway and the temporary session does not overwrite the kiosk refresh.

securityItems.pin: bcrypt PIN in the database only
securityItems.roles: Roles enforced on views and APIs

users.profilesHint: Pick the profile to use on this device (PIN required)
users.profilesReadOnly: Only an administrator or an elevated kiosk can switch profiles
users.note: Architecture note: roles and permissions are verified by the auth micro-service and enforced by the APIs. The restrictions shown here only hide or disable controls: a browser client is not a security boundary.

toasts.loadFailedDescription: The local gateway did not respond.
toasts.switchDeniedDescription: Only an admin or an elevated kiosk with PIN can switch profiles.
toasts.switchAction: The temporary session expires without revoking the device session.

pin.title: Confirm PIN
pin.description: Managing profiles requires an elevated session.

delete.title: Delete profile {{name}}?
delete.description: The profile and its sessions are removed from PostgreSQL. Commands already sent remain valid, but the account can no longer sign in.
delete.selfDescription: You cannot delete the profile you are using on this panel.

form.description: Credentials, role and PIN are verified by the server. Hashes never leave PostgreSQL.
form.kioskHint: Enables sign-in with device id + PIN, without a password.
form.kioskDeviceHint: Panel identifier; defaults to the username when empty.
form.pinHint: 4 to 6 digits. The PIN elevates the session and authorises protected actions.
form.pinKeep: Leave empty to keep the current PIN. Changing it updates the stored length.
form.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. It may stay empty for a kiosk.
form.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
form.activeHint: A disabled profile cannot sign in.
form.securityNote: PIN and password are stored only as bcrypt hashes.

errors.username: Username: 3-32 chars, lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.displayName: Display name can be at most 80 characters.
errors.kioskRole: The kiosk flag requires the kiosk role.
errors.kioskDevice: Device id: 2-64 chars among letters, digits and . _ : -
errors.pinDigits: The PIN must contain digits only.
errors.pinMismatch: The two PINs do not match.
errors.password: The password must be at least 8 characters.

security.title: Alarm system
security.description: System state and zones. Alarms are persisted on PostgreSQL by the gateway, so they stay visible even when the tablet was off or just rebooted.
security.pinArmDescription: Switching to “{{mode}}”: confirm with the security PIN.
security.pinDisarmDescription: Disarming the system always requires the PIN, even with an active session.
security.pinAction: The system changes state only after verification.

zones.title: Security zones
zones.description: A zone enabled in “home” triggers when armed at home, “away” only when armed away. 24H sensors are always active.
zones.empty: No sensors assigned yet: the worker maps them on first start based on the sensor type.

openSensors.title: Sensors not at rest: the system cannot be armed

history.title: Alarm history
history.description: Persistent log: no event is ever deleted, acknowledgements and resolutions stay tracked with who handled them.
history.resolvePinDescription: “{{title}}” will be closed and kept in the history.
history.empty: No alarms in the selected period.

topology.title: Devices and rooms
topology.description: PostgreSQL records. Every save invalidates the topology, updates the UI and realigns MQTT subscriptions without reloading the browser.

empty.devices: No devices match these filters. Create one or widen the search.
empty.rooms: No rooms yet. Create one to get started.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{label}}?
deleteDialog.deviceDescription: Its subscription is removed immediately and queued commands for this device will no longer be sent. This cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.roomDescription: A room can only be deleted when empty: move its devices first.

pin.title: Confirm PIN
pin.description: Changes to devices, rooms and users require an elevated session.

test.title: Test topic · {{name}}
test.description: Publish a payload to the broker as the device would, to verify adapter and subscriptions.
test.note: Publishing uses the broker base topic. The message also appears in the raw log below.

deviceDialog.description: Configure identity, adapter and topics. Sniffer mode listens to the broker and fills the fields from real traffic.

errors.id: The id must be a slug: lowercase, digits, - _ : and start with a letter or digit.
errors.order: Order must be an integer between 0 and 9999.
errors.topic: Invalid topic: no spaces or + / # wildcards.

sniffer.hint: Press the physical button on the device or trigger the sensor: raw messages appear here. Choose “Use this topic” to fill adapter and topics.
sniffer.empty: No messages yet: check the connection and press the device button.

roomDialog.description: The room appears in the overview, navigation and filters.
roomDialog.idHint: The id is generated from the name and cannot change after creation.

errors.name: Room name is required.
errors.order: Order must be an integer between 0 and 9999.
